findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-202.11  (P ) Plumbing is not designed , constructed and installed properly. Contact a licensed plumber to repair/replace to comply with Illinois Plumbing Code. 
When someone is using the spray hose to wash dishes, the handsink has about 10 seconds of flow and then stops. Inspector was trying to wash hands at start of inspection, while an employee was washing dishes, and was unable to complete handwashing until employee was done washing the dish. The handwashing sink does work properly as long as the spray hose in the dish area is not in use. The Handwashing Sink must be available without interruption at all times in the kitchen, not hindered by the use of other equipment. Follow up to occur Thursday 2/13/2020 to correct the issue. Contact a licensed plumber to repair connection to handsink and dish area.

findings.citation_text:
750.510 - Improper handwashing technique was observed. Faucet was shut off without barrier to drying hands with paper towels. findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
Mouse droppings discovered in three places in dry storage area.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED - Staff claims several mice have been caught in traps and Sentinel is due to come in for service tomorrow.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(1)  Floor of walk-in freezer is soiled (to the right, near the Popsicles).  (2) Floor in dish area, along wall, under pipes, is soiled.   (3)  Vaccuum/sweep mouse droppings as soon as possible.    Clean these floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
(3)  Edges of some of tiles in dish area are peeling.  Repair or replace these tiles.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Individual juice containers were 50F in sliding door cooler. Labeling stated to keep refrigerated. Juice containers were placed in the cooler around 6am and it was past 10am when the temperature was checked. The juice containers were discarded in the trash during the inspection. Cold potentially hazardous foods shall be held at 41F/below at all times.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.citation_text: 750.120 - Riblets in warmer were at 116F and the thermostat on the bottom read between 158F and 160F. Inspector's stem thermometer registered a temperature above 140F at the bottom of the unit and bags of buns half way up the unit had a surface temperature of 150F. Riblets were placed in the warmer from the oven prior to the arrival of the inspector. Riblets were placed back in the ovens to reheat product prior to serving. Hot potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at 135F/above. **Turn on the warmer in advance to ensure proper hot holding temperature is maintained**

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.citation_text: 750.140 - Sliding door cooler was at 50F. All potentially hazardous products were removed from the cooler. Milks inside the sliding door cooler had internal temperatures at 41F/below and were moved to the walkin cooler until lunch. Juice containers in the sliding door cooler were discarded (see #3a). A call for service will be made to Airmasters for the unit. Do not use the sliding door cooler for storage of potentially hazardous foods until is properly repaired and able to maintain product temperatures at 41F/below.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Sanitizer bucket used for general surfaces tested at 0ppm chlorine. Solution was remade to be at proper concentration. Maintain sanitizer solution at 100ppm chlorine. Use test strips to ensure proper concentration. Change out the bucket every 2-4 hours or more often as needed when rags and solution become heavily soiled.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) shelves & inside cabinets (dust/debris); B) bottom inside milk cooler (liquid/debris); C) bottom inside and tracks of sliding door cooler (debris); & D) inside sanitizer bucket used for general surfaces (grimy black buildup). Clean all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
